title: 🌼 Whisper of Daisies 🌼
content:
Light, airy, and effortlessly fresh — this look is a love letter to summer simplicity. The flowing silhouette stretches gracefully, just like a field of daisies swaying in the breeze. White petals bloom across the fabric, creating a pure and delicate vibe, while subtle textures add depth and movement. It’s softness turned into fashion, a dreamy ode to carefree days under the sun.

title: Topstitch Magic: Designing a Coach Chain in Clo3D
content:
Here’s how I created the **detailed Coach chain** for the bag I submitted to the competition. ✨  
I used the **Topstitch** feature, and **every step was modelled in Clo3D** , ensuring the final piece is as precise and realistic as possible. 

![80b66ee0b86b4465a94d2c7a9c8413b9](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202508/4592a0bf9ae44eefbd3e9445d94dc167/images/80b66ee0b86b4465a94d2c7a9c8413b91.png)![f9f862f8b2b142c3884bb7218681d3ff](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202508/4592a0bf9ae44eefbd3e9445d94dc167/images/f9f862f8b2b142c3884bb7218681d3ff4.png)![996601fff7e94ed69207bab064c8914b](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202508/4592a0bf9ae44eefbd3e9445d94dc167/images/996601fff7e94ed69207bab064c8914b2.png)![f98d5003968446ae8653aa356583a068](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202508/4592a0bf9ae44eefbd3e9445d94dc167/images/f98d5003968446ae8653aa356583a0683.png)![816e00125056446aa1c8e2548b75216a](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202508/4592a0bf9ae44eefbd3e9445d94dc167/images/816e00125056446aa1c8e2548b75216a3-2.png)![1a5126a44f554aa591c6e17d17357580](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202508/4592a0bf9ae44eefbd3e9445d94dc167/images/1a5126a44f554aa591c6e17d173575803-3.png)![6db2fad654dd4825a557ae67deec88f5](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202508/4592a0bf9ae44eefbd3e9445d94dc167/images/6db2fad654dd4825a557ae67deec88f5Melinda-Manunta-Coach-Bag.png)
